items.item: Uses Batch Apex (Database.Batchable) scheduled with a Schedulable class, not a loop of Queueables or a single transaction
items.evidence: `AccountScoreBatch implements Database.Batchable<SObject>, Database.Stateful`; `AccountScoreSchedule implements Schedulable` calls `Database.executeBatch(new AccountScoreBatch(), 200)`

items.item: Keeps queries and DML bulk inside execute, with no per-record SOQL
items.evidence: The `execute` loop only calls the pure `AccountScoring.score(a)` and collects rows into `changed`. It then makes one `Database.update(changed, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)` call per scope. There is no SOQL in `execute`.

items.item: Includes a test using Test.startTest() and Test.stopTest() that asserts results
items.evidence: `batchUpdatesScope200` wraps `Database.executeBatch` in `Test.startTest()` and `Test.stopTest()`, then runs `Assert.areEqual(15, a.Score__c, 'Score recalculated')`
